turns.text: Arre maine toh abhi abhi bataya na! Wax pighalna physical hai kyunki wapas solid ho sakta hai, aur baati jalna chemical hai kyunki naya black smoke wala stuff banta hai. Aur baati toh gayab ho jaati hai... jaise paper jal jaata hai, waisa hi hai. Haan yehi saboot hai. Par candle ki flame ki photo dikhao na? Yellow blue aag wali.

Aapne bataya tha, aur maine dobara pooch liya. Wax ka physical aur baati ka chemical badlav aapne sahi pehchana; ek saboot aur jodein: pighalne par wax, wax hi rehta hai. Flame ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak bataiye, baking soda mein nimbu ka ras daalne par kya dikhega, kya sunaayi dega, aur badlav physical hoga ya chemical?

Bubbles niklenge! Phizz phizz sound bhi karega, jaise Cold drink ki bottle khologe toh aati hai. Maine apni friend ke ghar pe try kiya tha volcano wala project. Chemical badlav hoga kyunki bubbles ban rahi hain, woh waapas nahi kar sakte. Par uski photo dikhao na? Jhaag jaisa bubble dikhao, mazaa aayega!

Aapne bubbles aur fizz ki prediction ki, aur volcano project bhi yaad aaya. Jhaag ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak sochiye, cold drink kholne par bhi bubbles aate hain, isliye sirf bubbles chemical badlav ka pakka saboot nahi. Do saaf solutions milane par safed solid bane, toh chemical badlav ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?

Haan solid bana toh matlab naya cheez hai... spoon mein jo black aata tha uski tarah? Toh sabse pakka saboot hai ki naya padarth ban gaya jiska rang alag hai. Par safed solid ki photo dikhao na? Aise hi test tube mein neeche baitha hua.

Haan, do saaf solutions se safed solid banna naya padarth banne ka mazboot saboot hai. Test tube mein neeche baitha safed solid ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak sochiye: baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat bani, jiske gun iron se alag hain. Yeh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur kyun?

Chemical change hai! Kyunki laal-bhoori parat bilkul alag cheez hai na, iron jaise shiny grey nahi hai. Aur woh parat wapas iron nahi ban sakti, jaise meri cycle ki chain pe bhi aisi hi jaal lage, papa ne oil lagake saaf kari thi, par woh parat alag thi, waapas metal nahi bani. Par uss parat ki photo dikhao na? Laal brown wali rusting wali.

Sahi, iron se alag gun wali laal-bhoori parat banna chemical change hai. Cycle chain par oil lagane se rust hata sakte hain, par rust wapas iron nahi banta. Rust wali railing ki photo banwa rahi hoon. Ab sochiye: cricket poster kaatna aur sparkler jalana, dono ko aasani se pehle jaisa nahi bana sakte; chemical change kaunsa hai, aur sirf wapas na bana paana kaafi saboot kyun nahi?

Sparkler jalana chemical change hai, kyunki usmein naya stuff banta hai... woh chamak wali cheez aur bhoosi jaisa bachta hai na? Poster kaatna toh sirf shape badalna hai, woh physical hai. Sirf wapas na bana paana pakka nahi hai, kyunki poster ko bhi wapas nahi jod sakte, par woh chemical nahi hai. Sabse zaroori saboot hai ki naya padarth banta hai... jaise sparkler mein light aur heat aati hai. P

Aapne poster ka shape badalne aur sparkler ke jalne mein naya padarth banne ka fark bataya. Ab cheeni paani mein gholne par ek prediction kijiye: pehle paani ka glass tola, phir usmein do chammach cheeni gholi. Wazan badhega, utna hi rahega, ya ghatega?

Wazan utna hi rahega? Kyunki cheeni toh paani mein ghul gayi, gayab ho gayi... toh wazan bhi gayab? Nahi wait, mamma kehti hai cheeni daalne se meetha hota hai, matlab cheeni andar hi hai na. Toh wazan badhega? Par dikhti nahi hai... pata nahi, shayad utna hi rahega, jaise hawa ka wazan nahi hota. Haan, utna hi rahega.

Aap soch rahi hain ki cheeni dikhti nahi, toh shayad uska wazan bhi nahi raha; phir meetha swaad yaad aaya. Cheeni ghulkar paani mein phailti hai, gayab nahi hoti. Taraazu par glass mein pehle se paani hai, phir do chammach cheeni bhi daali: ab wazan badhega, utna rahega, ya ghatega?

Badhega! Kyunki cheeni bhi toh wazan rakhti hai na, chhota sa daana hai par weight hai uska. Jaise mamma aata gundti hai toh parat bhaari ho jaata hai, dikhta nahi hai par wazan badh jaata hai. Waise hi cheeni paani mein chhup gayi par uska wazan toh add hoga na? Haan badhega.

Aapne kaha cheeni dikhna band hui, lekin uska wazan paani mein add hoga. Ab ek fark pakadte hain: Kunal kehta hai namak paani mein hilaane se pighal jaata hai. Use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye, aur woh pighalne se kaise alag hai?

Arre woh... ghulna bolna chahiye na? Pighalna toh chocolate ya ice cream ke liye hota hai, garam karne pe. Namak paani mein ghulta hai, gayab hota hai lekin pighalta nahi. Pighalne mein cheez apne aap change hoti hai, jaise solid se liquid, par ghulne mein paani ki help chahiye. Par screen pe chocolate wala drawing dikhao na? Pighla hua chocolate.

Namak paani mein ghulta hai aur usi paani mein rehta hai; chocolate pighalne par solid se liquid banti hai. Ab do drinks sochiye: ek mein room-temperature paani mein sugar ghulti hai, aur doosri mein chocolate garam hokar liquid banti hai. Inmein dissolving kis mein hai, aur kaise pata chala?

Dissolving sugar wale mein hua, kyunki woh paani mein mix ho gayi. Chocolate toh bas garam hui, shape badli. Aur haan sugar ab bhi hai paani mein, kyunki meetha toh hai na, nahi hota toh tasteless hota. Par iska kuch aur photo hai? Jaise glass mein chammach hilate hue, ya fir aloo dikhao?

Sahi, sugar paani mein ghuli aur meetha swaad batata hai ki woh ab bhi wahin hai; chocolate garam hokar pighli. Chammach se glass mein cheeni gholne ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; sochiye, daane dikhna band hote hain, par mithaas rehti hai. Ab garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur kya saboot hai?

Chemical change hai! Kyunki doodh phat gaya toh naya smell aata hai na, khatta smell. Aur taste bhi khatta hota hai, meri naani kehti hai iska paneer banao. Par woh doodh waapas nahi aa sakta, jaise dahi waapas doodh nahi ban sakti. Saboot hai smell aur taste change. Par phatte hue doodh ki photo dikhao na? Fridge mein rakhna bhool gaye toh aisa lagta hai.

Aapne khatti smell aur taste badalne ko saboot maana; doodh wapas na banna bhi ek clue hai. Phate doodh ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; usmein doodh alag-alag tukdon aur paani jaisa dikhega. Ab tyohaar ki mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kaunsa ho sakta hai?

Physical badlav ho sakta hai... ghee pighalna! Kyunki woh solid se liquid banta hai, bas state change hua. Aur chemical badlav... chashni banana? Jaise cheeni garam karte hain toh brown ho jaati hai, smell badalti hai, woh naya cheez ban gaya. Par kitchen mein mithai banti hui photo dikhao na? Kadhai mein garma garam jalebi tal rahi ho.

Aapne ghee pighalne mein solid se liquid hona pakda. Cheeni sirf paani mein ghule toh alag baat hai; garam hokar bhoori ho aur nayi smell aaye, toh chemical badlav ka saboot milta hai. Kadhai mein talti jalebi ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak ek seb ka tukda khula aur doosra nimbu-paani mein sochiye: kaunsa jaldi bhoora hoga, aur bhoora hona physical badlav hai ya chemical?

Arre woh plate wala jaldi bhoora hoga, kyunki hawa lagti hai na, jaise mummy apple kaatke rakhti hai toh kaala pad jaata hai. Nimbu-paani wala shayad nahi hoga, kyunki nimbu acidic hota hai, usse colour nahi badalta? Bhoora hona chemical change hai, kyunki naya colour aata hai aur waapas nahi kar sakte. Par nimbu-paani mein dooba apple dikhao na?

Aapne kaha khula seb jaldi bhoora hoga, aur nimbu-paani rang badalne ko dheema karta hai. Nimbu-paani mein doobe seb ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak sochiye, aluminium sheet ko dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banayein aur kuch milayein nahi, toh yeh physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur kyun?
